title: Mermaid dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ocean sparkles -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='55' r='1.2' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- hair back -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='30' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#e65100'/>
  <path d='M32 30 Q22 40 24 58 Q28 48 34 44' fill='#e65100'/>
  <path d='M60 30 Q70 40 68 58 Q64 48 58 44' fill='#e65100'/>
  <!-- torso -->
  <path d='M40 44 Q38 54 40 62 L52 62 Q54 54 52 44 Z' fill='#f8bbd0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='12' fill='#ffcc80'/>
  <!-- hair front -->
  <path d='M34 28 Q36 18 46 18 Q56 18 58 28 Q52 24 46 24 Q40 24 34 28 Z' fill='#ff6f00'/>
  <!-- hair side strands -->
  <path d='M34 28 Q30 36 32 42 Q34 36 38 32' fill='#ff6f00'/>
  <path d='M58 28 Q62 36 60 42 Q58 36 54 32' fill='#ff6f00'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='32' r='2' fill='#3e2723'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='2' fill='#3e2723'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='31.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='31.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 38 Q46 42 50 38' stroke='#bf360c' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ff8a80' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ff8a80' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- arms dancing -->
  <path d='M40 48 Q28 40 22 32' stroke='#ffcc80' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 48 Q64 40 70 34' stroke='#ffcc80' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc80'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc80'/>
  <!-- shell top -->
  <path d='M40 46 Q42 42 46 44 Q50 42 52 46 L52 48 L40 48 Z' fill='#ce93d8'/>
  <path d='M44 44 L44 48' stroke='#ab47bc' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M42 62 Q38 72 36 80 Q34 88 40 90 Q46 88 48 80 Q52 72 50 62 Z' fill='#26c6da'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M36 88 Q28 92 24 98 Q34 96 40 92 Q36 90 36 88 Z' fill='#00acc1'/>
  <path d='M40 90 Q48 94 52 98 Q44 98 40 92 Q38 90 40 90 Z' fill='#00acc1'/>
  <path d='M44 88 Q50 92 54 98 Q48 96 44 92 Z' fill='#4dd0e1'/>
  <!-- tail scales -->
  <path d='M40 68 Q46 72 50 68' stroke='#00acc1' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M38 74 Q46 78 52 74' stroke='#00acc1' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M37 80 Q45 84 51 80' stroke='#00acc1' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='none' stroke='#80deea' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='none' stroke='#80deea' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='none' stroke='#80deea' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
